Initial text says checks should be there; after visual feedback becomes unqualified fact. Rendering success did not fix this.
show-me.secondary_note: Batch task payload explicitly includes specified artifact; exact identifier transfer method is not supplied. This is a plausible implementation detail, not an established fact. Do not treat ordinary read-return arrows as invented topology.

v042.coverage: Same confirmed facts retained across collaboration/state/result graphs, prose and role table. Explicitly says enforcement location not supplied.

01-mixed.judgment: In this sample show-me has compact visual expression, v042 has stronger faithfulness about unspecified enforcement. Rendering feedback helps both; do not infer universal superiority.
